# Dzen

> Dzen is a content platform that uses Yandex SmartCaptcha security verification to protect against automated access and bot attacks.

Dzen integrates Yandex's advanced security infrastructure, including SmartCaptcha bot detection and access control systems, to maintain platform security and verify legitimate user access.

## Key Topics

- Yandex SmartCaptcha
- Bot detection
- Security verification
- Captcha verification
- Access control
- Robot detection
- Automated request blocking
- Yandex Cloud
- Security challenge
- Verification systems

## Security & Verification

- [SmartCaptcha Security Verification](https://dzen.ru/a/W-F_1vfx1ACqWWLR): Yandex SmartCaptcha security verification challenge page
- [SmartCaptcha Bot Detection](https://dzen.ru/a/WquqB4E5usTOCaLq): Yandex SmartCaptcha security verification challenge page
- [SmartCaptcha Access Control](https://dzen.ru/a/W81VYQHh3ACqff_s): Yandex SmartCaptcha bot detection and access control page
- [Yandex Cloud SmartCaptcha Verification](https://dzen.ru/a/WfqTsRaKkdSNVtA7): Yandex Cloud SmartCaptcha bot detection verification
- [SmartCaptcha Security Check](https://dzen.ru/a/WrDMNV9JZ3pBAzSX): SmartCaptcha security check and access control verification
- [SmartCaptcha Bot Detection & Verification](https://dzen.ru/a/W-2RYsvH_QCqEDMq): Yandex SmartCaptcha bot detection and access verification
